# env/packages-apt.txt
#
# Runtime apt manifest for the lean ubuntu:22.04 sandbox image.
# Line grammar:
#   name=version [INDEX-VERIFIED|INDEX-UNVERIFIED]
# [INDEX-VERIFIED] means the exact name=version pair appears in the live-verified jammy
# package table recorded for this case. [INDEX-UNVERIFIED] means the pin is a best-known
# jammy version not present in that recorded snapshot and must be confirmed against the
# apt index at image-build time before the image is trusted. Every non-comment line MUST
# carry exactly one of these two tags; an unlabelled pin is a hard failure of this case's
# own manifest gate.
#
# This file does NOT name a browser package. The jammy apt browser route is a transitional
# shim that redirects to a confinement-based packaging system that does not run in a plain
# container. The snap-free Playwright route is installed by this package's install.sh
# instead; see the LAYER 3b note below.
#
# This file does NOT name any Microsoft-licensed font installer package -- that route needs
# a network fetch plus EULA acceptance at install time and is deliberately dropped; see
# fonts.md for the full reasoning and for what is installed instead.
#
# This file does NOT name xvfb, x11vnc, a window manager, or any cua/computer-server package
# -- the GUI surface is supplied by the base image this package installs on top of.

# LAYER 1: base tooling
ca-certificates=20230311ubuntu0.22.04.1 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]
curl=7.81.0-1ubuntu1.20 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]
gnupg=2.2.27-3ubuntu2.4 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]

# LAYER 2: office suite
libreoffice-writer=1:7.3.7-0ubuntu0.22.04.12 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
libreoffice-calc=1:7.3.7-0ubuntu0.22.04.12 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
libreoffice-impress=1:7.3.7-0ubuntu0.22.04.12 [INDEX-VERIFIED]

# LAYER 3: PDF/OCR toolchain
ocrmypdf=13.4.0+dfsg-1 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
tesseract-ocr=4.1.1-2.1build1 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
tesseract-ocr-eng=1:4.00~git30-7274cfa-1.1 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
poppler-utils=22.02.0-2ubuntu0.13 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
qpdf=10.6.3-1 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
ghostscript=9.55.0~dfsg1-0ubuntu5.13 [INDEX-VERIFIED]

# LAYER 3b: browser -- supplied outside apt by install.sh (Playwright's bundled Chromium)

# LAYER 4: fonts
# Primary -- metric-compatible Times New Roman/Arial/Courier New substitute set.
fonts-liberation2=2.1.5-3 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]
# Guaranteed-resolvable fallback so serif/sans/mono metric coverage cannot be lost if the
# primary pin above needs adjusting; this exact pin is index-verified.
fonts-liberation=1:1.07.4-11 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
fonts-crosextra-carlito=20130920-1.1 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
fontconfig=2.13.1-4.2ubuntu5 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]

# LAYER 5: Python runtime
python3=3.10.6-1~22.04 [INDEX-VERIFIED]
python3-pip=22.0.2+dfsg-1ubuntu0.6 [INDEX-UNVERIFIED]
